description: AicodeX Edition 2 — CHAiMERA ConductorX multi-model orchestration with an optional local secrets vault.

secrets.note: The vault is LOCAL-ONLY. It is referenced by $VAULT:key entries below; never store real secret values in this file or commit the vault.

skeleton_architect.mission: Design the skeleton structure and overall code-base architecture.

formation_planner.mission: Set up the formation system, project scaffolding and TODO planning.

base_coder.mission: Write the base code structure on top of the skeleton.

error_patcher.mission: Run code-base error checks and apply patching refinements.

research_dev.mission: Research and develop fixes for errors and queries from internal build metrics; supply data feeds and algorithms for code-base requirement rectifications and enhanced performance.

security_netops.mission: Manage the security system, network topology and port-allocation structure.

spec_logger.mission: Produce full-spec logging and advanced mapping of workflows; align job building with code-base requirements, regulations and error prevention.

orchestration.description: Creates the symphony of structure and code accuracy for the user-desired output by sequencing the enabled roles.

hive.description: Hive cluster of model-driven VMware worker bots. In parallel the bots find bandwidth gaps and peaks/troughs, balance load into the troughs, and patch missing data bits with updated innovation-research results.
